stage: G1 source and adapter qualification before any fit

domain.unit_of_evidence: one source snapshot and one previously exposed flight; rows are not independent flights
domain.input_units: stored uint16-scale motor ratios after compensation, battery V, body gyro rad/s, body-to-world xyzw, host time s
domain.input_transform: Unchanged committed replay; no new alignment, resampling, compensation or parameter changes.
domain.exclusions: All other flight outcomes including training and final-test are outside this qualification probe. No alternative-dataset outcomes are scored.

source_scope: NanoBench pinned recursive Git tree and public branches/releases
NanoBench referenced paper and source links for collection/configuration/alignment artifacts
Collection firmware tag and existing source trace
If prerequisite fails: actual IDSIA nanodrone-sysid-benchmark main/dev source, published data schema and explicit licence terms; no model execution or test outcomes
qualification_requirements: Collection build/configuration trace beyond a version label
Motor and gyro raw per-block timestamps, or a reproducible acquisition/alignment pipeline that identifies their relative timing and interpolation
Preserved logging point, units and motor/body conventions checked against sources
Existing excerpt adapter replay reproduces its arithmetic and recorded increments
comparison_rule: Adapter reproduction compares deterministic fields to the committed excerpt audit; runtime is excluded. Source qualification reports recovered/missing evidence with specific locators. This is an estimation/access qualification with no invented physical error tolerance.
stop_rule: If collection timing/configuration remains inaccessible, stop at source qualification. Do not fit an empirical matrix as a workaround, estimate physical lag/delay, evaluate final-test data or certify G1/G2. Verify IDSIA identity, fields and rights before drafting an unsent request.
conditional_fit: If all timing/configuration prerequisites are recovered, commit a separate prospective candidate/selection protocol before any fitting, with the unchanged training/development split. No fit or hyperparameter choice is authorized by a failed qualification.

iteration_history.change: No model change. Fix source scope and exposed excerpt before the qualification run.
